core.note: Legacy Alpine chroot for app versions below 6. Do not repoint these keys: shipped builds < 6 read them directly and cannot be changed.

debian.note: Debian trixie arm64, same rootfs the rootless VM boots. arm64-v8a only.

rootless_v2.note: UML engine (kernel 7.2): UML binaries (linux-uml, stub_exe) come from the uml-mode-all-file release; the same rootfs boots both QEMU and UML. Guest is reached over SSH. arm64-v8a only. QEMU/libslirp shared with the rootless block.

uml_netd.note: Rootless UML network gateway (BESS vector transport): ARP/ICMP + TCP relay to 127.0.0.1:<same port> + DNS. CI re-pins sha256/size after each upload.

rootless.note: Local dev ships these inside the APK under assets/rootless/. This block is the OTA fallback; arm64-v8a only.

app.changelog:
OPX-Demon v1.2.0

## What's Changed
* fix(uml): drop UML_NET_VECTOR so the released static-link config is valid by @freebuff-web[bot] in https://github.com/OPX-Aminul/OPX-Demon/pull/5
* fix(uml): expose IOMEM/DMA emulation prompts (keeps USB-WiFi drivers in config) by @freebuff-web[bot] in https://github.com/OPX-Aminul/OPX-Demon/pull/6
* fix(uml): inline Kconfig prompt edit — builder image lacks patch(1) by @freebuff-web[bot] in https://github.com/OPX-Aminul/OPX-Demon/pull/7
* fix(uml): strip GCC-only -mabi=lp64 from Makefile.um for clang builds by @freebuff-web[bot] in https://github.com/OPX-Aminul/OPX-Demon/pull/8
* fix(uml): build from the original zalexdev/linux-um-arm64 tree for exact release parity by @freebuff-web[bot] in https://github.com/OPX-Aminul/OPX-Demon/pull/9
* fix(uml): re-assert the android --target so kbuild's linux-gnu override loses by @freebuff-web[bot] in https://github.com/OPX-Aminul/OPX-Demon/pull/10
* fix(uml): point kbuild's CLANG_TARGET_FLAGS at the android triple by @freebuff-web[bot] in https://github.com/OPX-Aminul/OPX-Demon/pull/11
* fix(uml): build against the API-34 bionic sysroot like the original release by @freebuff-web[bot] in https://github.com/OPX-Aminul/OPX-Demon/pull/12
* fix(uml): read the release banner without a SIGPIPE-killed strings pipe by @freebuff-web[bot] in https://github.com/OPX-Aminul/OPX-Demon/pull/13
* ci(uml): copy artifacts from /out — the build stage never wrote them to / by @freebuff-web[bot] in https://github.com/OPX-Aminul/OPX-Demon/pull/14
* ci(apk): install SDK packages explicitly — setup-android's default list wants the removed 'tools' package by @freebuff-web[bot] in https://github.com/OPX-Aminul/OPX-Demon/pull/15


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/OPX-Aminul/OPX-Demon/compare/v1.1.10...v1.2.0
